item.title: Fontlab 3D extrude script (python) not accurate
item.description: Having a problem with the default 3d Extrude script in fontlab. IT generate the shadow a little bit offset witch make it look missdesign. I’m sure it was report many time. But is somebody have a better python script or a workaround ?
